messages:
alex: FYI ran into a nasty duplicate-side-effect case when resuming streaming after a 429 + token-refresh. proposing an experiment to standardize a "safe replay" flow across SDKs so behavior is predictable for customers.

maria: ugh, yeah this bit us in the sample app yesterday. what do you mean by "safe replay flow"?

alex: two parts: 1) SDKs attach an Idempotency-Key header for non-streaming requests and maintain a small replay window for resumable streaming responses; 2) default retry/backoff params include jitter and a replay-hold check to avoid unbounded duplicate side effects.

chip: can we avoid adding too many knobs? parity across node/go/python libs is painful already. :grimacing:

alex: totally — goal is ONE simple opt-in primitive: `safeReplay: true` (off by default for now). SDK handles idempotency header + replay detection. app only has to opt in.

samir: curious about streaming resumes: how do we detect if a resumed stream re-executes a side effect (eg webhook)?

alex: idea: the runtime returns a resume token with the partial output. SDK stores last-acked token + logical request id. On resume, server will accept a `Replay-Window` TTL + `Last-Token` and decide whether to replay or fast-forward. SDK does exponential backoff with full jitter before attempting resume.

maria: can you paste the backoff defaults you're thinking of?

alex: sure. defaults we prototyped in the Go lib:

```json
{
  "max_retries": 6,
  "base_delay_ms": 200,
  "max_delay_ms": 5000,
  "jitter": "full",
  "retry_on": [429, 503, 504, "network_error"]
}
```

alex: and a tiny replay-related addition:

```http
Idempotency-Key: <uuid4>
Safe-Replay: true
Last-Resume-Token: <token|omit>
```

chip: looks reasonable. for Node we can map `Safe-Replay` -> `safeReplay` option that sets header automatically.

samir: what about auth rotation races? we saw token refresh causing two parallel retries. need an SDK-level singleflight to avoid double replays.

alex: yep singleflight is a must. SDK should coalesce parallel retries for the same logical request id and share result. if refresh happens, the refresh should be done once and pending requests resume against same new token.

maria: onboarding note: sample app needs to show best-practice for idempotent side effects. people expect setting header = good enough but streams are trickier.

alex: wrote a tiny sample app prototype: https://github.com/redwood/replay-safe-sample (WIP). includes an express webhook that is idempotent keyed by `Idempotency-Key`, and a streaming producer that demonstrates resume tokens.

chip: can we add a tiny e2e test in ci that simulates token rotation + 429 during streaming so we don't regress?

ci-bot: created issue #782 in devex: "e2e: simulate streaming 429 + token rotation (replay safe)" — @chip assigned.

samir: one more edge: how long should the server keep resume tokens? storage cost + privacy. maybe default 30s-2min depending on model latency.

alex: proposal: server default = 60s, but API lets customers set `replay_window_sec` per route for Dedicated/Private. Hosted keeps safe default.

maria: docs ask: how do we surface when a resume was fast-forwarded vs replayed? need observability.

alex: SDK should emit event hooks: `onReplayAttempt(details)` and `onReplayResult({status: "replayed"|"fast-forwarded"|"skipped"})`. Console will show a per-request trace.

chip: sounds good. next steps?

alex: 1) add a minimal Go prototype (done), 2) add Node + Python parity PRs that implement `safeReplay` opt-in, 3) sample app + e2e CI, 4) docs + console trace fields. i'll open PRs for (1) and (2) tomorrow.

maria: can you include a small README snippet we can paste into onboarding so customers know the tradeoffs? people will ask when it should be enabled.

alex: will do. quick blurb: "Enable Safe-Replay for endpoints that can tolerate at-most-once semantics; it reduces duplicate side effects at the cost of small added latency on resume attempts. Use idempotency keys and server-side dedupe for irreversible operations."

samir: :thumbsup: thanks. assigning to go/node/python SDK owners to review parity soon.

chip: also flag the UX in the Console — show when a request used "safe replay" so support teams can debug.

alex: added to the RFC checklist. thanks all.

maria: nice. excited to get this into the sampleapp so new users don't trip on this. :party_parrot:
